# Nightcore Tracker

> Daily Nightcore charts among monitored YouTube channels: breakout songs and rising channels by seven-day view growth, plus top songs and top channels by views gained. Rankings cover monitored channels only, not all of YouTube.

All pages are static HTML readable without JavaScript. The public data is plain JSON with no login. Dates are Europe/Madrid calendar days; timestamps are UTC.

## Documentation

- [Public data guide](https://nightcore-tracker.com/data-guide.html): files, schemas, units, null handling, time zone, cutoff, coverage and completeness status
- [Methodology](https://nightcore-tracker.com/#about): how the seven-day rankings are calculated

## Pages

- [Latest rankings](https://nightcore-tracker.com/): the four charts of the latest date
- [Latest discoveries](https://nightcore-tracker.com/discover.html): breakout songs and rising channels with the figures behind each entry, and links to every dated edition
- [Nightcore channels](https://nightcore-tracker.com/channels.html): monitored channels by total views

## Data and feeds

- [Manifest](https://nightcore-tracker.com/data/manifest.json): latest date and the dated snapshots currently published
- [Editions index](https://nightcore-tracker.com/data/editions/index.json): every dated discovery edition with its permanent page and data file
- [Channels](https://nightcore-tracker.com/data/channels.json): the channels shown on the channels page
- [Discoveries feed](https://nightcore-tracker.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0, newest editions first
